data.long_meaning: Derived from the German name Hans, meaning 'God's grace.' In folklore, Hansel and Gretel are children who rely on their wits and kindness to survive. The name Hanselka carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hanselka usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
